First post, because why the hell not.

FPS's on 4chan and reddit ended up being small fats admonishing larger obese folks because they wanted to make themselves feel better for their unhealthy lifestyles while still thinking they're better than others. But not here!

Unlike the predecessors, this subverse will not allow ego stroking in the form of back stories about weight loss, or comparative body types. If you post here, we assume you are of a reasonable BMI, within the similar constraints of /v/fatpeoplehate. Honestly, its the only way to stop this sub turning into a shit posting haven.

Also, a note on the rule about back stories; it used to be that these stories were short... concise. They were easy to read and gave a quick chuckle. Then 2 years or so after they hit reddit they turned into 9 peice epics that required lore research and an ability to distinguish between disambiguated names that sounded so similar the just melded in together. Unless it is REALLY required, please keep longer stories to 3 posts or less, unless mod approved.

No one cares about how you get all the 'hot guys' compared to the fatty, no one cares that you are somehow this super healthy, clean eating vegan freak... we want to read contextual encounters with fatlogic in the wild.

Post your suggestions for rules and moderation here.
